name: Aru Otoko no Ko no Isshuukan
source:
The story of Masato Susuki, a crossdresser and a survivor.

Today he's fucked again. His mother's boyfriend climbs atop the pretty boy, then sodomizes him...

One day Masato staggers out of the house...
allows a stranger to do him, and realizes the power of money. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172700.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
讲述了变装者兼幸存者铃木正人的故事。

今天他又被坑了他母亲的男朋友爬到这个漂亮男孩身上，然后鸡奸了他……

有一天，正人摇摇晃晃地走出家门……
允许一个陌生人做他的事，并认识到金钱的力量。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172700.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
